summary: Toivo Group Oyj operates as a real estate company. It engages in real estate property development, construction, ownership, management, and leasing. The company also develops lots, constructs houses, and owns and sells apartments and residential, as well as offers rented plots. In addition, it provides project management contracting services. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Espoo, Finland. Toivo Group Oyj operates as a subsidiary of Raatihuone Oy.
